summary: Describes the inventory object methods: add_group, add_child, add_host (with optional group and port), and set_variable.
questions: How do I add a host to a specific group in an inventory plugin?
How do I nest a group under another group programmatically?
How do I set a host variable from my inventory plugin?

answer_card.title: Inventory object methods
answer_card.answer_md:
- `add_group(name)`: add group if missing
- `add_child(parent, child)`: add existing group/host to a parent group
- `add_host(name, group=None, port=None)`: add host, optionally to a group with an int port
- `set_variable(entity, varname, value)`: set a var on a host or group

More in `lib/ansible/inventory/data.py`.
